sections.description: A named, reusable row filter on the declaring entity (FR-044). Measures and reports reference it by name; exporters emit it as a named segment.
sections.whenToUse: The same filter (e.g. 'active purchase') would otherwise be repeated in several measures or reports.

attrs.name: filter
attrs.description: The row scope: a portable attr.filter over the declaring entity's fields. May use relative-date values.
